description: How much protection options traders buy, from Cboe's daily market statistics: the total, equity, index, ETF, VIX and SPX put/call ratios of the latest trading day with the calls and puts traded, and the total, equity, index and SPX ratios day by day with their 10- and 20-day averages. A plain summary first. No key.

days.description: Trading days shown, latest last; default 20.

name: options_sentiment

outputSchema.description: rows are trading days (oldest first) with the total, equity, index and SPX put/call ratios; latest has every ratio and the volumes, averages the 10- and 20-day means.

title: Options sentiment: put/call ratios (Cboe)
